objective: Create the provider-neutral server-side orchestration boundary for immediate and callback contact requests. Resolve the actual transport destination from canonical River CRM data, enforce current consent before provider invocation, persist queued and attempting execution state, and record provider acceptance or failure without selecting or implementing a telephony vendor.

rules: The destination is resolved only after loading the canonical CRM relationship.
The destination is not added to InsuranceGrowthIntegrationContext.
The provider adapter does not fetch River CRM.
The provider request receives the resolved destination explicitly.
The destination is not redundantly persisted on the contact-attempt row.

sequence: Validate request identity and context relationship agreement.
Use the newest consent record for the requested channel.
Return denial without provider invocation when ineligible.
Transition and persist the attempt to attempting before provider invocation.
If accepted, retain attempting state and persist provider reference when supplied.
If rejected, transition and persist failed state.
If provider throws, transition and persist a stable retryable provider-exception failure.

acceptanceCriteria: Actual destination comes from canonical River CRM relationship data.
InsuranceGrowthIntegrationContext remains free of phone and email transport values.
Provider request includes explicit server-resolved destination.
Current requested-channel consent is re-read before provider invocation.
Queued state is durable before attempting state.
Attempting state is durable before provider invocation.
Provider acceptance does not prematurely mark the attempt completed.
Provider rejection becomes failed state with canonical failure fields.
Provider exception becomes stable retryable failed state.
No network or production resource is touched.
